# tools/luaurun -controls). One patch per line: name, the src file, the needle (which must occur
# exactly once in that file; \n and \t spell a newline and a tab) and its replacement, TAB
# separated. Each control deletes ONE refusal rule from a copy of the unit, every line of its name
# applied (a rule this port keeps in several places is deleted from each), and the conformance
# corpus run against it must fail exactly the vectors of conformance-controls/<name>.expected. unknown-operation patches nothing: it adds
# conformance-controls/unknown-operation.txt to the corpus, whose one vector must fail.

# through serialize_int, so ranged-range and ranged-reconstruction patch each place.

# rule, 3f40cb5f): with either left in, an empty nested object after a refusal still refuses.
